thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: 429 surge detected for customer 'Prism Labs' (VPC: vpc-prism-prod, pool: dedicated-pool-4). 5m window: 18% 429s, p50 latency 420ms. dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/d/alloc/dedicated-pool-4

maria: acked. I'm on-call, pulling logs and recent deploys.

kevin: pinging infra-oncall, standing by to apply pool-level mitigations if needed. any customer impact reported?

prism-support: We started seeing errors ~09:12 UTC. Our app gets intermittent 429s on generation requests, mostly 1-3s after request. Nothing in our code changed at that time, we did a large reindex job earlier this morning.

aya: noted — checking tenant-level metrics. early sign it's one noisy tenant inside Prism (tenant-42) with huge parallel batches.

maria: runbook step1: confirm pool saturation and tenant isolation. step2: try fair-share throttling for tenant-42 and observe. step3: if still not stable, shift a percentage of Prism traffic to dedicated-pool-5 (backup).

kevin: I can apply a temporary per-tenant fairshare via admin API. will try a soft cap first (50 req/s) on tenant-42.

lee: if we do per-tenant cap, we should also enable automatic fallback routing for the customer's lower-priority traffic to the cheaper model variant to protect p95 for others.

sam: copying runbook snippet:
```
# throttle tenant via admin API
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/tenants/tenant-42/policies \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"fair_share_qps":50, "reason":"emergency-mitigation: noisy tenant during Prism surge"}'
```

kevin: applying now...

incident-bot: pagerduty: Incident #INC-8421 created and notified SRE rotation.

kevin: applied cap, API returned 200. policy_id=ps-2026-8421.

maria: monitoring... initial drop in 429 rate to ~9% within first 30s. p50 latency down to 300ms.

prism-support: confirming — 429 spikes reduced, but some long-running batch requests still hit timeouts. that was our reindex job, can pause?

ashley: @prism-support if you can pause the reindex it would help. we can also offer a temporary throughput boost if you need the job to finish. that would be a contract override (manual approval).

prism-support: pause scheduled, but we need ETA for finalization of many queued jobs. they'd prefer we keep it running and accept some throttling.

maria: ok. two parallel tracks: 1) keep cap in place and observe, 2) if customer insists on throughput, we can issue a timebound capacity override to the dedicated pool (requires AE sign-off).

sam: AE note — issuing override requires adding a billing note and setting expiry. command below to add ephemeral capacity: 
```
# ephemeral override (requires AE token)
curl -X POST https://billing.redwood.internal/v1/overrides \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AE_TOKEN" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"customer_id":"prism-labs","pool":"dedicated-pool-4","extra_qps":2000,"expires_at":"2026-03-15T11:00:00Z","note":"emergency throughput for reindex; auto-revoke"}'
```

ashley: I'm on it. I'll add the billing note and set expiry to +60m.

kevin: FYI we also found 2 hosts in the pool with elevated kernel wakeups — could be noisy VM or OS-level interference. i'll cordon host-34, migrate active sessions.

lee: migrating sessions, running live eviction policy that preserves kv caches where possible.

maria: 10m update: 429s down to 3.2%, p50 210ms, p95 1.2s. Tenant-42 still high error rate but internal requests are shaping.

prism-support: thanks team — seeing significant improvement. their devs will throttle batch concurrency on their end to avoid hitting the cap.

ashley: override request submitted and approved by AE. override id OV-5552 created; expires in 60m. billing note attached.

kevin: cordoned host-34 and migrated ~18 user sessions. metrics show host CPU normalized.

aya: adding follow-up action items: 1) recommend Prism implement per-tenant rate limiting on client side and exponential backoff, 2) we should add tenant-visibility alerts in our console to detect noisy tenants earlier, 3) investigate OS-level noisy-neighbor on host-34.

maria: handing off to infra rotation for post-incident cleanup. @kevin you're owning host remediation and migration notes. @lee please capture runtime changes. I'll draft incident summary and action items.

kevin: will follow up in infra ticket INF-9812.

lee: I'll open runtime ticket RT-4021 for smooth fallback and model-variant routing improvements.

maria: final status: customer impact limited to Prism's internal batch jobs; external API clients saw reduced errors after cap + override. Incident will be marked mitigated. :white_check_mark:

prism-support: appreciate the fast response. please share the postmortem and recommended guardrails.

maria: will circulate postmortem within 24h and schedule a short technical review with Prism next week. tagging tasks: [INF-9812], [RT-4021], [CS-2245].

ashley: billing action completed and notes synced to customer-facing ticket. :memo:

incident-bot: Incident #INC-8421 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria: closing thread here — follow-ups assigned. thanks all. :wave:
